lifecycles._note: Light, self-contained ROLE lifecycle covering 7 role write ops. A real role create->read->update->bindings->delete is attempted in group 'role-real'; every step is optional so an environmental 500/400/403 (the prior disabled iam-role saw POST /v1/roles -> 500 ContactAdminForAssistance) records coverage on the CALL and skips the rest of the group cleanly rather than failing the run. Bodies grounded on api_bodies.json (createrole/setrole/setroletrustpolicy/addrolepolicybindings). assume_role_policy_document uses an empty Resource and no real Principal (principals[] empty) to avoid referencing a non-existent user SRN. policy_ids sent empty on create; the binding steps then add/remove a placeholder policy id (synthetic -> expected 400/404). The standalone group 'role-bulk' exercises DELETE /v1/roles/bulk and the bindings DELETE endpoints against ids that need no real role (bulk delete of an empty/synthetic set), so those writes are CALLED even if role create 500s. RISK (from docs, not runtime-proven): create role may 500 on this account; bulk role delete body shape (role_ids) is from convention, not a confirmed example -> _note on that step. Create response envelope $.role.id confirmed from createrole 202 doc example.

SAFETY (Hard Rule 3): the 'pol-bulk' group exercising DELETE /v1/policies/bulk (management/iam/deletepolicies) was REMOVED — verified on live runs #124 (unmatched synthetic id) AND #125 (a valid OWNED id, body $.id correct) that the SCP backend IGNORES the policy_ids body entirely and fans the call out into a delete-ALL-account-policies attempt (#125: 422 policy.delete.start over 832 attempts / 417 delete.error across 237 distinct NON-test system policies — AdministratorAccess_ACL, ObjectStorageAccess, PaaSCommon-*, …). No request body makes this endpoint safe; it is un-probeable and waived (data/baselines/coverage_waivers.json, class blast-radius).

lifecycles._note: Light, standalone. Covers the resource-policy write ops: PUT/DELETE /v1/resource-policies/{srn}, POST /v1/resource-policies/{srn}/statements, PUT/DELETE /v1/resource-policies/{srn}/statements/{sid}. KEY FIX (2026-06-20): the iam gateway decodes {srn} path segments as base64 — plain SRN yields 400 'SRN decoding error'; segment MUST be base64-encoded. KEY FIX (2026-06-23): Action in resource-based policy body MUST match the target resource's service (iam:* 400s 'UnSupportedActionInPolicy'; * also 400s; kms:* confirmed 200 against a KMS SRN). Strategy: filter resourcemanager list by resource_type=kms so the captured SRN is always from the kms service, then use kms:* action. Cleanup: setresourcepolicy creates a real policy -> deleteresourcepolicy MUST run as cleanup (destructive). Also: setpermission/removepermission need the real Sid used in addpermission; both use literal 'Statement2' which matches the addpermission body. VALIDATED 2026-06-23: setresourcepolicy 200, showresourcepolicy 200, addpermission 201 (kms:*), setpermission 200, removepermission 204, deleteresourcepolicy 204.

steps.name: list-kms-resources
steps._note: Soft-capture a KMS SRN. FIXED 2026-07-08 (0x89 수사): resourcemanager 페이지네이션은 0-인덱스이고 크기 파라미터는 'size'다 — 종전 {page:1, page_size:10}은 (a) page_size가 무시되고(응답 echo size:20) (b) page=1이 '두 번째 페이지'라, 계정 kms 자원이 5개뿐인 현재 resources:[] 빈 페이지를 받아 캡처가 미스났다 (라이브 실측 2026-07-08: page=1 → count:5, n_items:0 / page=0 → 5건 + 실 srn). 2026-06-23의 '20 kms resources' 시절엔 21번째 이후 항목이 page=1에 있어 우연히 동작. KMS SRN 필수 이유: resource-based policy Action이 service와 일치해야 함 — kms:* 확정. 403/빈 페이지면 iam_srn 미해결 → 아래 b64 게이트가 lifecycle을 환경 스킵.

steps.name: b64-encode-iam-srn
steps._note: Base64-encode the captured KMS SRN for /v1/resource-policies/{srn} path segments (iam gateway가 {srn} 세그먼트를 base64로 디코드; management__resourcemanager.json b64-encode-srn과 동일). NON-OPTIONAL GATE (FIXED 2026-07-08): optional이던 시절엔 iam_srn 캡처 미스 시 이 스텝이 조용히 continue → iam_srn_b64 미설정 → 경로에 리터럴 '{iam_srn_b64}' 송신 → 게이트웨이가 그 리터럴을 base64url 디코드(중괄호는 비알파벳으로 skip, 'iam_srn_b64' → 0x89 a9 bf b2 …) → 400 "SRN decoding error: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x89 in position 0" 가짜 실패 발생 (2026-07-08 라이브 런 실측; 산술 재현 검증됨). 이제 미해결 입력이면 엔진이 LifecycleSkip(깨끗한 환경 스킵, 선행 생성 자원 없음)으로 바꾼다 — 쓰레기 경로 호출 자체가 나가지 않는다.

steps.name: set-resource-policy
steps._note: setresourcepolicy — PUT /v1/resource-policies/{srn}. CONFIRMED 200 2026-06-23: kms:* action is valid for a KMS SRN. Creates a resource policy (group 'rp-real'; cleanup deletes it). Action changed from iam:* (400 UnSupportedActionInPolicy) to kms:* (200). Expect_status narrowed to [200,201,202]: we now have confirmed 2xx (strict 유지 = role verify 불변). 2026-07-08 런의 400 "SRN decoding error … 0x89 in position 0"는 제품결함도 b64 인코딩 누락도 아님 — list 캡처 미스(페이지네이션 버그)로 리터럴 플레이스홀더가 송신된 가짜 실패 (근본수리: list-kms-resources page=0/size + b64 스텝 non-optional 게이트; 각 스텝 note 참조). b64 경로 역학은 실 SRN으로 라이브 재검증됨 2026-07-08 (GET show가 b64 세그먼트를 원문 SRN으로 정확 복호, req-a3b1dd4b).

steps.name: show-resource-policy
steps._note: showresourcepolicy — EXPLICIT GET /v1/resource-policies/{srn} on the REAL b64-encoded KMS SRN (iam_srn_b64) right after set-resource-policy created the policy. The probe-resource-policy-reads auto-seed below already fires this GET at runtime, but probe_reads steps are invisible to the static step->catalog union — this explicit strict-200 step closes that gap (COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08). CONFIRMED 200 2026-06-23 (same GET via the probe, policy present). Group rp-real gates it on setresourcepolicy success, so strict [200] never fires without the policy. (정정 2026-07-08: 종전 note의 '0 kms resources' 진단은 오진 — 실제로는 kms 자원 5개 존재, list의 page=1이 빈 두 번째 페이지였음. 수리 후 캡처 미스 시나리오는 b64 게이트의 LifecycleSkip으로 lifecycle 전체가 깨끗이 환경 스킵되므로 이 스텝은 placeholder로 발화하지 않는다. b64 경로 자체는 실 SRN GET으로 라이브 확인 — 404 'No Policy found with ID srn:e::…' = 세그먼트 복호 정상, req-a3b1dd4b.)

Without this explicit mapping, probe_reads can't resolve {srn} (ctx has 'iam_srn_b64', not 'srn'; _PARAM_ALIASES only has 'rg_srn' for srn). The probe fires GET /v1/resource-policies/{iam_srn_b64} after setresourcepolicy created the policy -> 200. Records under catalog key management/iam/showresourcepolicy. steps._note: id-bound read (showsamlprovider). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/saml-providers/{saml_provider_id}. Keys off the create-soft-captured saml_provider_id; tolerant [200,400,403,404] because the create body is UNPROVEN (corrupt api_bodies.json entry) and 4xx's, leaving saml_provider_id a placeholder (normalizes to the catalog '*' key, still records coverage). HEAVY-gated with the rest of this lifecycle; the GET is CALLED so the endpoint is statically reachable.

steps.name: set-saml-provider
steps._note: setsamlprovider: corrupt body in api_bodies.json; best-effort guess; synthetic id.

steps.name: delete-saml-providers-bulk
steps._note: deletesamlproviders: CONFIRMED body key is 'ids' (not 'saml_provider_ids') from api_docs.json request_example 2026-06-24. Synthetic id -> 404 ResourceNotFound (vs 400 ValidationError with empty array or wrong key). Not coverable to 2xx without a real SAML provider (createsamlprovider requires multipart/form-data or HEAVY opt-in).

lifecycles._note: Light, READ-ONLY (no writes, no cleanup). Closes 4 static id-bound GET gaps for read-only / list-discoverable IAM resources by the list->soft-capture->show idiom (the same pattern cloudcontrol uses for its list-discovered ids). +2 strict-200 bare global lists appended 2026-07-08 (listendpoints, listsamlprovider — COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08). access-keys and service-accounts have only list+show in the catalog (no create), so a synthetic id would be a guaranteed-404 dead read — instead we soft-capture a REAL id from the caller's own list and show it. account-users is shown via the account_id soft-captured from the caller's access-keys list (access_key.account_id) + a user id from the account-users list itself. Every step is optional with tolerant [200,400,403,404]: on an account with no access keys / service accounts the list is empty/403 and the dependent id segment stays a {placeholder} (normalizes to the catalog '*' key) so the show is still CALLED and the endpoint statically reachable. Envelopes grounded in data/api_docs.json response examples: accesskeylist $.access_keys[].{id,account_id}; listserviceaccount $.service_accounts[].id; listiamuser $.users[].id.

steps.name: list-access-keys
steps._note: Zero-param list (already in the smoke GET floor) reused here to soft-capture a REAL access_key_id + the caller's account_id (accesskeylist envelope $.access_keys[]). Drives the two id-bound shows below.

steps.name: show-access-key
steps._note: id-bound read (accesskeyshow). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/access-keys/{access_key_id}. Keys off the list-captured access_key_id (a real id when the caller has any key); if none, the segment stays a placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*') and 4xx's. Tolerant [200,400,403,404]; the GET is CALLED so the endpoint is statically reachable.

steps.name: list-account-users
steps._note: id-bound read (listiamuser) — Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/users. account_id is soft-captured from list-access-keys (the caller's own account); the segment normalizes to catalog '*'. Also soft-captures a real user id ($.users[].id) to drive show-account-user. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: show-account-user
steps._note: id-bound read (showiamuser). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/users/{user_id}. Both segments are placeholders (account_id from list-access-keys, account_user_id from list-account-users) -> normalizes to v1/accounts/*/users/* matching the catalog. If either is uncaptured the show 4xx's harmlessly while still recording coverage. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: list-service-accounts
steps._note: Zero-param list (smoke GET floor) reused to soft-capture a REAL service_account_id (listserviceaccount envelope $.service_accounts[]). Drives show-service-account.

steps.name: show-service-account
steps._note: id-bound read (showserviceaccount). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/service-accounts/{service_account_id}. service-accounts is read-only in the catalog (list+show only, no create), so a synthetic id would be a guaranteed-404 dead read — instead this keys off the list-captured real service_account_id. If the caller has no service accounts the segment stays a placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*') and 4xx's. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: delete-account-users-bulk-empty
steps._note: deletebulkiamuser (DELETE /v1/accounts/{account_id}/users/bulk). CONFIRMED 2026-06-24: empty user_ids array [] returns 204 (idempotent, no users deleted). account_id is soft-captured from list-access-keys (the caller's own real account id). This is NON-HEAVY because no IAM users are created or deleted — the empty array is a no-op. Covers the catalog key management/iam/deletebulkiamuser.

steps.name: list-endpoints
steps._note: listendpoints — GET /v1/endpoints (zero-param global read: the per-region service endpoint directory; docs declare no parameters at all). LIVE-CONFIRMED 200 2026-07-08 (returns $.endpoints[] with region/service_name/url entries). strict [200]. Completeness-audit 편입 (COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08).

steps.name: list-saml-providers
steps._note: listsamlprovider — GET /v1/saml-providers (zero-required-param global list; size/page/sort/federation_type/saml_provider_name all optional). SAML WRITES stay in the heavy probe lane (iam-credentials-heavy) — this is the bare list only. LIVE-CONFIRMED 200 2026-07-08 (count 0, empty saml_providers[] — empty-list 200 is the expected steady state on this account). strict [200]. Completeness-audit 편입 (COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08).

lifecycles._note: coverage-agent iam 2026-07-16: access-key CRUD (accesskeycreate/set/delete/deletebulk, 4키) — 이전엔 iam-credentials-heavy(SAML/실유저와 묶여 SCP_RUN_HEAVY 필요)에서만 시도되던 항목을 가벼운 자체완결 lifecycle로 분리 (VM/DB급 과금 없음, 실행 즉시 삭제되는 단순 크리덴셜이라 heavy 게이팅 불필요하다고 판단). 라이브 실측 확정 사실: (1) accesskeycreate는 body에 account_id REQUIRED (문서+실측 일치; account_id 생략 시도는 과거 미검증) — self-discovery로 채움. (2) 응답 envelope은 전부 {"access_key": {...}} 로 래핑 ($.access_key.id, NOT flat $.id). (3) 계정 쿼터 IAM.USER.ACCESS_KEY.MAX.COUNT=2EA 확인 (3번째 키 생성 시도 -> 403 iam.quota.value.exceeded) — 이 lifecycle은 항상 그룹 순차 진행(ak1 전부 정리 후 ak2 시작)으로 동시 보유 키 수를 쿼터 이하로 유지한다. (4) accesskeydelete(단건)·accesskeydeletebulk 둘 다 키가 is_enabled:true인 상태로는 400 'Iam.AccessKeyEnabled'로 거부된다 (처음엔 단건 delete는 예외라고 오판했으나 재현 결과 둘 다 동일 요구사항으로 정정) — 반드시 accesskeyset으로 disable 후 delete. RISK: 각 create의 'cleanup' 백스톱은 disable 없이 바로 delete를 시도하므로, create~explicit-delete 사이에서 크래시하면 cleanup이 400으로 실패할 수 있다(좁은 창; 해피패스는 항상 명시적 disable→delete 순서를 탄다). secret_key/access_key 값은 절대 로그·노트에 남기지 않는다(비밀자료).

steps.name: create-access-key-2
